prompt: Edit the supplied Itsy Web logo specimen to make a close variation of its WOVEN LOOP symbol. This is a refinement of the existing loop idea, not a new concept. Preserve the specimen layout, pale background and navy strip. Change only the large symbol at upper left, its standalone version at lower left and its reversed version on the navy strip; the three must depict the same revised mark. The mark is one broad strand turning through itself, with a navy body, a short ice-blue crossing and a clean central opening. Keep it bold, compact, softly rounded and clear at favicon size. Flat vector-style artwork in #142b43 and #a4dbff on #f5f9ff; no gradients, shading, added text, labels or mockup objects. Variation C: SQUARED LOOP. Refine the woven loop into a compact softly squared form with three decisive rounded turns and one clear geometric central aperture. Keep the original diagonal crossing and interwoven construction, but replace the loose oval rhythm with more deliberate straights and generous corner radii that echo the wordmark. A small ice-blue crossing sits on the upper-left edge; the rest is navy. It should feel precise and distinctive, not like a cube, hexagon, shield, generic app tile or link icon. No enclosing square background.
preserve: Approved wordmark typography, palette and specimen layout
